question: Does the Flight Day 6 camera-action retrieval mismatch recur across the complete raw crew-camera archive?
terminal_objective: Remove the single-day scope limit before treating action reconstruction as an archive-level requirement.
method: Complete all-flight-day, label-only raw crew-camera acquisition followed by the Stage 10C camera-native bracket oracle
authority: Read-only public metadata acquisition and private local repository updates only. No image pixels, publication, outreach, scientific acceptance, or correction of source labels.

interpretation.verified: Across all ten flight-day labels, 21 of 2,103 complete raw crew-camera exposure brackets cross activity facets. Every observed fracture is on Flight Day 6; the other 382 qualifying complete brackets contribute no fracture.
interpretation.inference: Concentration on the dense lunar-observation day is more consistent with an observation-specific scheduling or curation interaction than with a generic representation failure, but it does not identify the cause.
interpretation.decision_use: Reconstruct complete camera actions before counting or sampling Flight Day 6 observations by activity; retain ordinary activity filtering as a coarse discovery aid elsewhere unless a new changed case appears.

claim_ceiling: Stage 10E may establish the complete raw crew-camera exposure-bracket denominator across all flight days, the observed fracture count, and its Flight Day 6 concentration. It cannot declare non-Flight-Day-6 images error-free, infer that lunar-flyby complexity caused the concentration, generalize the bracket rate to non-bracket products, identify correct activity labels, or invalidate Flight Day 6 activity facets wholesale.

next_step_logic.if_no_cross_day_recurrence: Keep the retrieval warning targeted to Flight Day 6 camera-action analysis and test the documented timestamp-plus-human-override mechanism against the repeated position signatures.
next_step_logic.if_cross_day_recurrence: Compare fracture signatures and metadata-generation contexts by flight day before narrowing the recommendation.
next_step_logic.if_no_complete_brackets_outside_fd6: Do not use cross-day silence as counterevidence; seek a different camera-action class.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised PDS label version, another complete multi-frame action class, or a documented activity-tag generation log may change the concentration interpretation.
